class.name: INI
class.brief_description: Reads and writes INI text as dictionaries, and any [Resource] as INI.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Creates a [Resource] from INI [param text] written by [method serialize]. The class comes from the key [code]$type[/code] of the section [code][root][/code], or from [param type_hint]. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if the text can't be read. The same as [code]ResourceTextSerializer.deserialize(text, ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_INI, type_hint, options)[/code].

method.name: erase_section
method.description: Erases the section [param section] with all its keys. Does nothing if it does not exist. Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: erase_section_key
method.description: Erases the key [param key] of the section [param section]. The section is erased too if it is empty afterwards. Does nothing if the key does not exist. Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: from_config_file
method.description: Replaces the data with the sections and keys of [param config]. Returns [constant OK], or an error code if [param config] is [code]null[/code]. Drops the kept parsed text. The [ConfigFile] is not changed.

method.name: get_section_keys
method.description: Returns the keys of the section [param section] in file order, or an empty array if the section does not exist.

method.name: get_sections
method.description: Returns the names of all sections in file order. The section [code]""[/code] for keys before the first header is included if it has keys.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the value of [param key] in [param section], or [param default] if the section or key does not exist. Like [method ConfigFile.get_value], it prints an error if it does not exist and [param default] is [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_section
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the section [param section] exists.

method.name: has_section_key
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the section [param section] has the key [param key].

method.name: load_encrypted
method.description: Loads the encrypted INI file at [param path], using the 256-bit AES [param key] it was saved with by [method save_encrypted]. Works like [method ConfigFile.load_encrypted]. Returns [constant OK] or an error code.

method.name: load_encrypted_pass
method.description: Loads the encrypted INI file at [param path], using the [param password] it was saved with by [method save_encrypted_pass]. Works like [method ConfigFile.load_encrypted_pass]. Returns [constant OK] or an error code.

method.name: parse_string
method.description: Parses the INI [param text] and returns its sections. Returns an empty [Dictionary] and prints the error if the text can't be read. Use [method TextDataFormat.parse] for the error details.

method.name: save_encrypted
method.description: Saves the data as an encrypted file at [param path], using the 256-bit AES [param key]. Works like [method ConfigFile.save_encrypted]. Returns [constant OK] or an error code. Save to [code]user://[/code] in exported games.

method.name: save_encrypted_pass
method.description: Saves the data as an encrypted file at [param path], using the [param password]. Works like [method ConfigFile.save_encrypted_pass]. Returns [constant OK] or an error code. Save to [code]user://[/code] in exported games.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Returns [param resource] as INI text: one section per resource ([code][root][/code], [code][root/main][/code], [code][root/entries/0][/code]) with one key per stored property, and the type marker [code]$type[/code]. [code]null[/code] [param options] uses the project settings [code]filesystem/resources/text_formats/*[/code]. Returns an empty [String] and prints an error if the resource can't be written. The same as [code]ResourceTextSerializer.serialize(resource, ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_INI, options)[/code].

method.name: set_value
method.description: Sets the value of [param key] in [param section]; the section is created if needed. A [code]null[/code] [param value] erases the key, and the section if it is empty afterwards, like [method ConfigFile.set_value]. Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: stringify
method.description: Writes the sections in [param data] as INI text. Every value of [param data] must be a [Dictionary] of keys; the section [code]""[/code] is written first, without a header. [param options] sets the value syntax ([member SerializerOptions.ini_value_style]) and the order of sections and keys ([member SerializerOptions.sort_keys]); [code]null[/code] uses the project settings. Returns an empty [String] and prints an error if a section is not a [Dictionary], a section name contains [code]][/code] or a line break, or a key is empty.

method.name: to_config_file
method.description: Returns a new [ConfigFile] with the sections and keys of this [INI]. Changes to the [ConfigFile] do not change this instance.
